description: This file defines the UserDecorator class in PHP, which provides additional functionality to the User entity, such as setting related Employee and UserRole entities, checking admin status, and managing non-hashed passwords. It utilizes traits and interacts with other entity classes within the same project.

classes.name: UserDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the User entity, providing methods to assign related entities, check user roles, and manage password data without modifying the original User class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a User entity.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Protected method that returns the decorated User entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee reference on the User entity based on the employee number.

methods.name: setUserRoleById
methods.description: Sets the UserRole reference on the User entity based on the role ID.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the User entity has a UserRole with the name 'Admin'.

methods.name: getNonHashedPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the non-hashed password stored temporarily in the decorator.

methods.name: setNonHashedPassword
methods.description: Sets the non-hashed password in the decorator.
